_doc: Hand-written item balance (docs/ITEMS.md). params = numbers read by the item code (src/core/item_effects.gd); desc = tooltip template: {name} param, {name|s} milliseconds shown in seconds, {name|%} ratio shown in percent, {stat.ATK} a stat of the item. stats = overrides of data/pac/items.json (generated). Change a number here and both the game and its tooltip follow.

SOUL_DEW.desc: During combat, the holder gains {ap} AP and {pp} PP every {interval|s} s

REAPER_CLOTH.desc: The holder's ability can now critically strike based on CRIT_CHANCE. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by {crit_power|%}% instead.

POKEMONOMICON.desc: When the holder deals SPECIAL, they BURN the target for {burn|s} seconds and reduce its SPE_DEF by {spe_def}.

ABILITY_SHIELD.desc: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW receive {shield|%}% of their max HP as SHIELD and SAFEGUARD for {safeguard|s} seconds

POWER_LENS.desc: The amount of SPECIAL blocked by SPE_DEF is inflicted back to the attacker

SHELL_BELL.desc: Holder heals for {lifesteal|%}% of all damages inflicted

HEAVY_DUTY_BOOTS.desc: Holder is immune to any BOARD_EFFECT, forced displacement and LOCKED

AQUA_EGG.desc: The holder regains {pp_ratio|%}% of its max PP after casting its ability, + {pp_per_cast} PP for each cast done in the fight

BLUE_ORB.desc: Every {every} attacks, unleashes a chain lightning that bounces to the {bounces} closest enemies, dealing {damage} SPECIAL and burning {pp_burn} PP

SCOPE_LENS.desc: Critical attacks steal {pp_steal} PP from the target ON_HIT.

STAR_DUST.desc: After casting ability, gain {shield_ratio|%}% of max PP as SHIELD

GREEN_ORB.desc: Holder and ADJACENT allies regain {heal|%}% of their max HP every {interval|s} seconds. {overheal_pp|%}% of overheal is converted to PP.

DEEP_SEA_TOOTH.desc: Holder restore {pp} additional PP ON_ATTACK. If the attack knocks out the target, restore {pp_on_kill} additional PP.

SMOKE_BALL.desc: Once below {hp_threshold|%}% max HP, drop the smoke ball, gain {shield} SHIELD and jump to a tile away. Every ADJACENT enemy is PARALYSIS and BLINDED for {duration|s} seconds.

XRAY_VISION.desc: Holder is immune to SLEEP and their attacks can no longer miss.

RAZOR_FANG.desc: Attacks apply ARMOR_BREAK for {armor_break|s} seconds ON_HIT.

PROTECTIVE_PADS.desc: Holder deals {shield_mult}x damage against units with SHIELD, and is protected from recoil damage and retaliation effects.

LOADED_DICE.desc: Attacks have [{chance|%},LK]% chance to also hit the lowest health enemy ADJACENT to target for {damage|%}% of the damage, which also trigger ON_HIT effects.

PUNCHING_GLOVE.desc: Attacks deal {max_hp_damage|%}% of target max HP as additional PHYSICAL ON_HIT

MUSCLE_BAND.desc: When the holder takes damage, gain 1 stack. Every {stacks_per_buff} stacks, the holder gains +{def} DEF, +{atk} ATK and +{speed} SPEED (max {max_stacks} stacks)

WONDER_BOX.desc: At the beginning of each battle, WONDER_BOX is replaced by {count} temporary random craftable items (max 3 items held)

STICKY_BARB.desc: When struck by an attack at melee range, deal {damage} + {def_ratio|%}% of DEF as retaliation TRUE and inflict WOUND for {wound|s} seconds to the attacker.

SAFETY_GOGGLES.desc: Holder is immune to all negative status effects and to sandstorm damage

KINGS_ROCK.desc: +{stat.HP} HP. {shield|%}% of max HP are gained as SHIELD when combat begins.

SHINY_CHARM.desc: Prevents damage and give PROTECT for {protect|s} seconds and {pp} PP the first time the holder gets below {hp_threshold|%}% HP

GRACIDEA_FLOWER.desc: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW gain +{speed} SPEED

FLAME_ORB.desc: Holder increases its BASE ATK by {base_atk|%}% and is immune to FREEZE, but suffers from BURN during the entire fight.

ASSAULT_VEST.desc: +{stat.SPE_DEF} SPE_DEF. Reduce BURN and POISONED damage by {dot_reduction|%}%

POKE_DOLL.desc: Reduce all incoming PHYSICAL and SPECIAL by {reduction|%}%. Makes the holder more likely to be targeted.

RED_ORB.desc: {true_part|%}% of attack damage is dealt as TRUE

MAX_REVIVE.desc: Give RESURRECTION, preventing the holder first KO and restoring to max HP

ROCKY_HELMET.desc: +{stat.DEF} DEF. Negates critical bonus damage from all incoming critical hits.
